patch_list: Opens the app without an internet connection.
Stops Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Facebook and OneSignal from collecting usage data.
Removes app open, interstitial and native ads, and the promoted apps list.
Removes the prompts asking for a rating.
Resume videos opened from other apps
Resumes videos opened from a file manager or gallery where playback stopped.
Opens the app without waiting on the splash screen.
